name: Banseiki Sengoku 1534 shared starting knowledge, 22 majors and UI

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('ruleset changed') end; HideGameSetup(); return 'Sengoku setup refreshed'

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()~=GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() then error('not turn 1') end; if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_SENGOKU_STARTING_KNOWLEDGE_GRANTED_V1')~=true then error('initial grant marker missing') end; local techs={['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRRIGATION_WORKS']=true,['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_COASTAL_PILOTAGE']=true,['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRON_FORGING']=true,['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_EARTHWORK_FORTS']=true}; local civics={['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_HOUSE_RULES']=true,['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_KOKUJIN_LEAGUES']=true,['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TEMPLES_AND_BELIEVERS']=true}; local majors=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors(); if #majors~=22 then error('major count '..#majors) end; local nt,nc=0,0; for row in GameInfo.Technologies() do nt=nt+1 end; for row in GameInfo.Civics() do nc=nc+1 end; if nt~=32 or nc~=30 then error('tree count '..nt..'/'..nc) end; for _,p in ipairs(majors) do local id=p:GetID(); local t=p:GetTechs(); local c=p:GetCulture(); for row in GameInfo.Technologies() do if t:HasTech(row.Index)~=(techs[row.TechnologyType]==true) then error('tech mismatch '..id..':'..row.TechnologyType) end end; for row in GameInfo.Civics() do if c:HasCivic(row.Index)~=(civics[row.CivicType]==true) then error('civic mismatch '..id..':'..row.CivicType) end end; for boost in GameInfo.Boosts() do if boost.TechnologyType and t:HasBoostBeenTriggered(GameInfo.Technologies[boost.TechnologyType].Index) then error('unexpected eureka '..id..':'..boost.TechnologyType) end; if boost.CivicType and c:HasBoostBeenTriggered(GameInfo.Civics[boost.CivicType].Index) then error('unexpected inspiration '..id..':'..boost.CivicType) end end; for _,moment in ipairs(Game.GetHistoryManager():GetAllMomentsData(id,1) or {}) do local info=GameInfo.Moments[moment.Type]; if info and (string.find(info.MomentType,'MOMENT_TECH_RESEARCHED',1,true) or string.find(info.MomentType,'MOMENT_CIVIC_CULTURVATED',1,true)) then error('starting knowledge caused historic moment '..id..':'..info.MomentType) end end end; return 'all 22 majors have exactly 4 techs and 3 civics; no boosts or research moments'

local expected={['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRRIGATION_WORKS']=true,['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_COASTAL_PILOTAGE']=true,['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRON_FORGING']=true,['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_EARTHWORK_FORTS']=true}; local live=GetLiveData(); if not live then error('TechTree has no live data') end; local count,done=0,0; for id,_ in pairs(g_kItemDefaults) do count=count+1; local row=live[id]; if not row then error('TechTree missing node '..id) end; local completed=row.Status==ITEM_STATUS.RESEARCHED; if completed~=(expected[id]==true) then error('screen completion mismatch '..id) end; if completed then done=done+1; if not row.IsRevealed then error('completed node hidden '..id) end end end; if count~=32 or done~=4 then error('screen counts '..count..'/'..done) end; return 'TechTree: 4 completed of 32'

local expected={['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_HOUSE_RULES']=true,['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_KOKUJIN_LEAGUES']=true,['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TEMPLES_AND_BELIEVERS']=true}; local live=GetLiveData(); if not live then error('CivicsTree has no live data') end; local count,done=0,0; for id,_ in pairs(g_kItemDefaults) do count=count+1; local row=live[id]; if not row then error('CivicsTree missing node '..id) end; local completed=row.Status==ITEM_STATUS.RESEARCHED; if completed~=(expected[id]==true) then error('screen completion mismatch '..id) end; if completed then done=done+1; if not row.IsRevealed then error('completed node hidden '..id) end end end; if count~=30 or done~=3 then error('screen counts '..count..'/'..done) end; return 'CivicsTree: 3 completed of 30'
